        "Vertical downward: (Fx,Fy)=(0,-F)",
        "Horizontal rightward: (Fx,Fy)=(F,0)",

      "effect": "layout"

      "effect": "layout"

        "Volume fraction over designable elements only, excluding passive regions"

      "effect": "layout"

      "category": "material",

        "E=70 GPa",
        "E=210 GPa"

      "effect": "scale_only"
    },

      "entity": "Poisson ratio",

        "ν=0.45"

      "effect": "layout"

    {

        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness for a 2D model",

      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in normalized units",
        "Uniform thickness of 1 mm",
        "Uniform thickness of 10 mm"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",

        "Two linear triangular elements per structured-grid cell"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {

      "issue": "vague",

        "Fixed p=2",
        "Fixed p=3",
        "Continuation from p=2 to p=3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density bounds and void-stiffness regularization",

        "ρ∈[0,1], with E(ρ)/E0=10^-9+(1-10^-9)ρ^p",
        "ρ∈[0,1], with E(ρ)/E0=10^-6+(1-10^-6)ρ^p",
        "ρ∈[10^-3,1], with E(ρ)/E0=ρ^p"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter use, type, and kernel",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 discusses filters generically without stating whether Fig. 1 uses one or identifying its operation and kernel.",
      "readings": [
        "No filter",
        "Sensitivity filter with a conical distance-weighting kernel",
        "Density filter with a conical distance-weighting kernel",
        "Density filter with Gaussian weights"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter length scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No filter radius, physical length scale, or mesh-relative radius is specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius of 1.5 element widths",
        "Radius of 3 element widths",
        "Radius of 0.05 times the domain height"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter treatment at domain and passive-region boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The generic filter discussion in Sec. 2.1 does not define neighborhood extension or normalization near boundaries.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate neighborhoods to included elements and renormalize weights",
        "Extend exterior values as zero and retain the full kernel normalization",
        "Reflect density values across the exterior boundary"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density projection and its parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The discussion of encouraging binary densities does not establish whether a projection is used or specify its threshold, sharpness, or continuation.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection",
        "Heaviside projection with threshold η=0.5 and fixed sharpness β=1",
        "Heaviside projection with η=0.5 and fixed β=8",
        "Heaviside projection with η=0.5 and β continued from 1 to 16"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "optimization update method and step controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 reviews methods without assigning an update algorithm to Fig. 1. Sec. 4.1's reference to ToPy for the dataset does not supply this example's settings.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria updates with density move limit 0.2 and damping exponent 0.5",
        "Optimality-criteria updates with density move limit 0.05 and damping exponent 0.5",
        "MMA updates with density move limit 0.1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design-density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No initialization is specified. This matters because Sec. 2.1 explicitly notes non-convexity and convergence to local optima.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform density equal to the target volume fraction",
        "Initially solid designable domain",
        "Target volume fraction plus an alternating ±0.01 checkerboard perturbation"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "optimization termination criteria",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No convergence tolerance, iteration cap, or rule for completing continuation stages is given for Fig. 1.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop at maximum element-density change below 0.01 or 200 iterations",
        "Stop at maximum element-density change below 0.001 or 1000 iterations",
        "Stop when relative compliance change stays below 10^-5 for ten iterations, after all continuation stages"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "finite-element equilibrium-solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The FEA references do not specify equilibrium-solver accuracy. Different approximate solves can affect sensitivities and the optimization path.",
      "readings": [
        "Direct linear-system solve",
        "Iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 10^-8",
        "Iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 10^-4"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
